newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea applications for share buy-back down in H1.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea applications for share buy-back down in H1.

text.p: Applications by South Korea's listed firms to buy back their own common shares in the first half fell 70.2 percent to 238 billion won from 799.5 billion a year earlier, the Securities Supervisory Board said on Friday.
A board statement said the major reasons for the companies' buy-back was to boost their own stock prices or stabilise their management rights.
Meanwhile, 16 companies applied to sell their own shares worth 11.1 billion won during the period against 8.8 billion won worth a year earlier. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5647
